title: bitbucket fetch_config
description: Per-repository merge settings and branch restrictions, built by the connector.

default_branch.description: Main branch name; may be empty.

default_merge_strategy.description: Absent when the branch call failed. May be empty.

merge_strategies.description: Absent when the branch call failed. null when Bitbucket sent none.

branch_restrictions.description: Bitbucket branch-restriction objects, verbatim. Absent without repository:admin or when there are none.
